description_en: Queries all account groups within the current management account or delegated administrator account
description_zh: 查询当前管理账号或委派管理员账号下的所有账号组列表
kebab_example: aliyun config list-aggregators --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cmNlU2hhcmVzJjE1MTI2NjY4NzY5MTAzOTEmMiZORnI4NDhVeEtrUT0 --max-results 10 --tag Value=value-1 Key=key-1 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAggregators

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of `NextToken`
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in a request. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key must be 1 to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs`:. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag values.

The tag values can be an empty string or up to 128 characters in length. The tag values cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

Each key-value must be unique. You can specify at most 20 tag values in each call
fields.help_zh:
账号组的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20。该值可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The tags of the resource.

You can add up to 20 tags to a resource
parameters.help_zh:
资源的标签。

最多支持绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

schema.description_en: This operation does not return any operation-specific parameters

Aggregators.description_en: The list of the account groups

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the management account that is used to create the account group
AccountId.description_zh: 创建账号组的企业管理账号ID

AggregatorAccountCount.description_en: The number of member accounts in the account group
AggregatorAccountCount.description_zh: 账号组内的成员账号数量

AggregatorCreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp generated when the account group was created

AggregatorId.description_en: The ID of the account group

AggregatorName.description_en: The name of the account group

AggregatorStatus.description_en:
The status of the account group. Valid values:

0: The account group is being created.
1: The account group was created
AggregatorStatus.description_zh:
账号组状态。取值：
0：创建中。
1：创建完成

AggregatorType.description_en:
The type of the account group. Valid values:

RD: global account group.
FOLDER: account group of the folder.
CUSTOM: custom account group
AggregatorType.description_zh:
账号组类型。取值：
RD：全局账号组。
FOLDER：资源夹账号组。
CUSTOM：自定义账号组
